p0.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 300 mm segmented diamond blade for porcelain and ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. The closely spaced J-slot segments let water and slurry clear the cut, so the blade runs cooler and faster than a continuous rim through dense porcelain, while the narrow slots keep the edge clean. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Porcelain and ceramic floor tiles, including 20 mm pavers
  • Fast production cutting on 300 mm saws

Specifications

  • Diameter: 300 mm
  • Segmented (J-slot) rim for ceramic
  • Wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • For cuts that will be on show in glazed or polished tile, the 300 mm continuous rim blade gives a smoother edge.
  • For granite and marble use the segmented granite blade, which has a different bond.
  • Keep the water flowing. A dry run heats the segments and shortens blade life.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 300 mm segmented diamond blade for granite and marble on bridge wet saws. Stone needs a different bond to porcelain, and this blade's wide segments clear the heavy slurry that granite and marble throw, so it keeps cutting instead of glazing over. It comes with a 30 mm bore and a reducer to 25.4 mm. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Granite benchtop offcuts, thresholds and paving
  • Marble, travertine and other natural stone tiles

Specifications

  • Diameter: 300 mm
  • Bore: 30 / 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Segmented rim for granite
  • Raimondi lists it as Art. 179SET300G

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Stone blades cut porcelain slowly and wear fast on it. Use the ceramic blades for tile.
  • Keep the water on and feed steadily. Stone chips if you rush the last few centimetres.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 350 mm segmented diamond blade for porcelain and ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. The closely spaced J-slot segments clear slurry and run cool through dense porcelain, and the 350 mm size gives the Zoe and SMS their full depth of cut for thick pavers and stepped cuts. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Porcelain and ceramic floor tiles, including 20 mm outdoor pavers
  • Deep cuts where a 300 mm blade runs out of depth

Specifications

  • Diameter: 350 mm
  • Segmented (J-slot) rim for ceramic
  • Wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • With a 350 mm blade the Zoe Advanced cuts 110 mm deep and the SMS 100 mm deep in one pass.
  • For granite and marble use the 350 mm segmented granite blade instead.
  • Not for the Pikus Advanced, which takes 230 to 250 mm blades.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 350 mm segmented diamond blade for granite and marble on bridge wet saws. The stone bond and wide segments clear the heavy slurry that granite throws, so the blade keeps cutting through thick stone, and the 350 mm size gives you the full depth of cut on the Zoe and SMS. It comes with a 30 mm bore and a reducer to 25.4 mm. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Granite and marble slabs, steps and paving
  • Thick natural stone that needs the extra depth

Specifications

  • Diameter: 350 mm
  • Bore: 30 / 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Segmented rim for granite
  • Raimondi lists it as Art. 179SET350G

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Stone blades wear quickly on porcelain. Use the ceramic blades for tile.
  • Keep the water on and ease off at the end of the cut so the stone does not chip.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 360 mm economy segmented diamond blade for brick, block, pavers and other general building materials. It is the blade to fit when the saw is doing site work rather than finish tiling: the wide segments chew through masonry and concrete products quickly, and the 360 mm size gives the biggest depth of cut these saws can take. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Clay and concrete pavers, bricks and blocks
  • Cement sheet and other masonry products

Specifications

  • Diameter: 360 mm
  • Bore: 30 / 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Segmented rim for masonry
  • Raimondi lists it as Art. 179SET360E

Fits

  • Raimondi SA 80, SMS and Zoe Advanced wet saws (the 14 inch class: Raimondi's catalogue lists 300 to 360 mm blades for them), 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • With a 360 mm blade the Zoe Advanced cuts 120 mm deep in a single pass.
  • A masonry blade will cut porcelain but chips the glaze. Use the ceramic blades for tile.
  • Check the blade guard clears a 360 mm blade on your saw before fitting.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Optional manual feed kit for the Raimondi Bulldog Advanced bullnosing and bevelling machine. It extends the working length of the machine so longer treads, benchtop edges and skirting runs can be fed through the diamond wheels by hand, rather than being limited to what fits on the standard table. The Bi-Bulldog takes its own version of the kit, available to order.

Fits

  • Raimondi Bulldog Advanced (this kit)
  • Raimondi Bi-Bulldog Advanced (separate kit, RAI-BIBULLMFK, to order)

Good to know

  • The Bulldog Advanced on its own profiles pieces up to 80 cm long and from 4 to 60 cm wide.
  • Feed at a steady pace and keep the piece hard against the fence so the profile stays even along the full length.
  • Raimondi's side extensions and connecting piece are the other ways to handle long material on the Bulldog.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Pair of attachment arms that link two Raimondi profiling machines in line, so a long piece runs straight from one into the next. Set a Bulldog up to shape and a second Bulldog or a Bi-Bulldog to finish, and a stair tread or benchtop edge goes through both in one pass instead of being handled twice.

Fits

  • Raimondi Bulldog Advanced
  • Raimondi Bi-Bulldog Advanced
  • Raimondi Back-Finisher

What's in the box

  • Pair of connecting arms

Good to know

  • Level both machine tables to each other before you run a piece, or the second machine will take an uneven bite.
  • Each Bulldog profiles pieces from 4 to 60 cm wide and up to 80 cm long on its own table; the side extensions take that to 120 cm.
  • Keep both water pumps running so the wheels stay cool along the whole run.

p7.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi continuous rim diamond finishing wheel for half bullnose edges on the Bulldog and Bi-Bulldog profiling machines. It is the second step: after the segmented shaping wheel has roughed out the radius, the fine grit continuous rim takes out the ridges and leaves a smooth edge ready for polishing. Choose the radius to match your shaping wheel: 8, 10, 15, 20 or 30 mm.

Fits

  • Raimondi Bulldog Advanced and Bi-Bulldog Advanced

Specifications

  • Profile: half bullnose
  • Radius: 8, 10, 15, 20 or 30 mm
  • Continuous rim, fine grit (Raimondi's 1/2 bullnose finishing wheels, Art. 179BULL10RF to 179BU30RF)

Good to know

  • Three steps give the best edge: shaping wheel, finishing wheel, then the polishing wheels through the grits.
  • Suits marble, granite and porcelain. Keep the water pumps running so the wheel stays cool.
  • On a Bi-Bulldog, run the shaping wheel on one motor and this wheel on the other to finish in a single pass.
